ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Filled CTA buttons, primary action backgrounds — deep saturated orange that reads as confident rather than playful, the only color with enough chroma to anchor a click target against the white field

tangerine-blaze.$description: Tangerine Blaze — Promotional surface fills (email capture modal, featured product cards, stat callout backgrounds) — slightly brighter and more luminous than Ember, used where orange must own an entire region of the layout

apricot-whisper.$description: Apricot Whisper — Borders on outlined cards, link underlines, icon strokes, accent hairlines — the lightest orange, functioning as a warm-tinted structural color rather than a fill

graphite-black.$description: Graphite Black — Body text, default borders, the dominant structural color — a true near-black, not warm, used for the bulk of hairline rules and paragraph copy

inkwell.$description: Inkwell — Heading text, navigation text, primary headings — a deep black with the faintest cool-green undertone that gives headlines a quiet cast against pure white

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, card surfaces, text on dark/orange surfaces — the unchanging ground tone across every section

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — Soft card borders, hairline dividers on white surfaces where Graphite would feel too heavy

smoke.$description: Smoke — Secondary captions, muted helper text, subdued icon strokes — the only mid-gray in the palette, used sparingly to fade metadata without going fully light

onest.$description: Sole brand typeface. The 200-300 weights at display sizes (48-152px) define the editorial couture voice — thin strokes hung on a white wall with aggressive negative letter-spacing. Weights 400-500 handle body and UI; 600-800 reserved for occasional emphasis. Substantial negative letter-spacing contracts large text to the width of small, producing the 'cut from a single line' effect. Substitute with Inter or General Sans if Onest is unavailable.

times.$description: Times — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
